prototype:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: production visual direction prototype for an offline Android reading game for children age 5–6.
Primary request: one polished portrait 9:16 mobile game screen, flat friendly hand-cut cartoon shapes, cream, mint, warm yellow and coral accents, broad simple color fills, crisp thick rounded shapes, generous spacing, no realism, no gloss, no texture, no 3D.
Subject: Chinese character reading and pinyin aloud game. A very large dark Chinese character '班' inside a warm ivory central round card; small friendly original yellow bird reading companion at lower left of the card. Three large rounded pinyin chips in a row showing exactly 'b' 'ān' 'bān', visual sequence of initial, final and complete word. Bottom very large mint microphone button, a short row with three stars, small score badge '85'. Top title exactly '开口读拼音', left back chevron, right speaker icon, tiny progress dots. Airy pale cream background, a few simple mint leaves near outer corners. The character dominates; chips and controls remain large. Minimal text, no paragraphs, no explanatory captions, no device frame. Realistic implementable app hierarchy, all tappable buttons at least 48 pixels. Art direction consistent and charming, foreground uses clean dark teal outlines.
Constraints: Do not imitate branded characters. No English app title, no random letters, no many panels or tiny labels, no gradient background. Deliver the flat mobile UI prototype image only.
readingBird:

Primary request: a cheerful original tiny yellow bird child holding open a mint green picture book and reading aloud, full body, three-quarter front view facing slightly right, expressive wide friendly smile, two round rosy cheeks, stubby wings, small orange beak, simple orange feet, one small raised feather. Flat preschool cartoon cut-paper illustration with clean smooth dark teal outlines and large solid bright color shapes, no 3D, no texture, no glow, no gradients, no shading, no text, no letters, no symbols. The friendly reading companion should look attractive to 5–6 year old children. Centered isolated full object with large transparent margins. Transparent background, no floor, no cast shadow, no border. Do not copy any branded characters.
